abilities.name: Might Of The Nerazim
abilities.text: If a Friendly Unit loses the HIDDEN Status, it gains Buff Speed (2) and its first Weapon used CRITICAL HIT (2).

abilities.name: Darkness Descends
abilities.text: The active Biological Unit gains the HIDDEN Status until the End of the Round.
